verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Conditional Access can gate access based on device state, app, and MFA (microsoft-entra-docs-2/8/16/19/22), supporting per-app/group context-aware policies, but the evidence pack lacks detail on location- and risk-signal-driven policies specifically. Community evidence concretely contradicts the robustness of this control surface: a documented downgrade attack lets attackers bypass FIDO/Conditional Access enforcement (microsoft-entra-comm-6/7/8, with a practitioner adding a VPN workaround because CA couldn't be trusted), and Actor tokens are explicitly noted as not subject to Conditional Access at all (microsoft-entra-comm-1). missing for 10: explicit documentation of location- and risk-based (Identity Protection) signals driving policy, and resolution/patch evidence for the downgrade-attack bypass.
